title: Fix search response leaks in async search tests

timeline.message:
Fix search response leaks in async search tests

Fixing all of these muted test classes, tried my best to keep indention changes to a minimum
but it wasn't possible to avoid them in all cases unfortunately.
timeline.author: Armin Braun

timeline.body:
Fixing all of these muted test classes, tried my best to keep indention changes to a minimum but it wasn't possible to avoid them in all cases unfortunately (review is quite short using `&w=1` no worries :)).
Had to make 2 adjustments to the test infrastructure so that it releases both created transport and rest responses properly. 

closes #104838

This is my only concern in this PR. Its weird to make such a broadly impacting change just for some other test suites. But, from what I can tell, this should have always been this way once: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/65921 was merged in the long long ago. 

Am I correct in thinking this? Or is this change solely because of the async search test failures?

reply.body: You are correct :) This should've always been there. We just didn't see any issues yet because we weren't using the logic with pooled stuff (or may also be missing a couple leak tracker uses here and there, I never got around to adding the tracker to old pooled code now that I think about it).
